mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 > 2% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are expected due to the consistent growth in housing starts (HOUST), a leading indicator of demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 6-month moving average and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) is growing above 1% QoQ, S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be positive over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances meeting both trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a monetary tightening cycle, a 25bps increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a higher likelihood of negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of tightening cycle instances with +25bps FEDFUNDS hike.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of quarters with RSAFS > 5% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on, Interaction-driven: The combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS > 100k MoM) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with both conditions met.
